instructions: The consultant must attack the AI-generated engineering content itself. These questions determine whether the engineering is genuine or AI-generated filler.

questions.question: Which engineering statements are genuinely source-backed?
questions.what_to_check: Each claim should trace to an external source (FDA, PubMed, ISO standard, published literature). Statements without source backing should be classified AI_INFERENCE or UNKNOWN.
questions.expected_failure: Some statements may claim EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT without actual source URL or citation

questions.question: Which are external precedent?
questions.what_to_check: External precedent should cite specific FDA-cleared devices, published papers, or patent documents — not generic 'standard practice'
questions.expected_failure: Some citations may be too generic (e.g., 'published literature' without specific reference)

questions.question: Which are model-derived?
questions.what_to_check: Model-derived values should reference R332 or specific computational model with documented parameters
questions.expected_failure: Some MODELLED values may lack derivation documentation

questions.question: Which are engineering proposals?
questions.what_to_check: ENGINEERING_PROPOSED values should have basis_ids and derivation fields per R370D
questions.expected_failure: Some proposals may lack basis_ids (required by R370D evidence class schema)

questions.question: Which appear unsupported?
questions.what_to_check: Any numerical value without evidence_class or with UNKNOWN evidence_class but containing numbers
questions.expected_failure: R370C should have caught these, but consultant should independently verify

questions.question: Which numbers cannot be independently traced?
questions.what_to_check: Every number in the dossier should be in ENGINEERING_NUMBER_REGISTER.json or explicitly UNKNOWN. Consultant should spot-check 5-10 numbers per package.
questions.expected_failure: Some numbers may be in the dossier but not in the register

questions.question: Which standards are wrongly applied?
questions.what_to_check: Each standard should be in ENGINEERING_STANDARD_REGISTER.json with correct applicability. Consultant should verify ISO 7197 (not ISO 7437), ISO 10993 series, IEC 60601, etc.
questions.expected_failure: Some standards may have wrong applicability_basis (e.g., IEC 60601 applied to passive device)

questions.question: Which CAD/drawings are merely illustrations?
questions.what_to_check: All packages should have engineering_artifact_status = CONCEPTUAL or ABSENT. No package should claim RELEASED_FOR_PROTOTYPE or higher without actual artifact.
questions.expected_failure: All should be CONCEPTUAL — any higher is a fabrication

questions.question: Which BOM items are speculative?
questions.what_to_check: BOM items with 'UNKNOWN' material or 'UNKNOWN' supplier are speculative. Consultant should count how many BOM items are fully specified vs UNKNOWN.
questions.expected_failure: Most BOM items likely have UNKNOWN material/supplier (correct honest state)

questions.question: Which manufacturing statements are generic?
questions.what_to_check: Manufacturing statements should NOT contain '±0.05mm typical' or 'Standard X process'. All should say 'UNKNOWN — process capability to be established'.
questions.expected_failure: R370C should have caught these, but consultant should independently verify
